messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR that adds a tiny 'conn-checker' for Windows (PowerShell) and a lightweight bash version for ARM edge nodes. Also added a short section on IPv6 dual-stack gotchas for Private/VPC installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
ashwin: Thanks — can you add an nftables example? A few customers run nft by default and our iptables snippets confuse them. Also call out MTU=1450 for VXLAN/tunnel setups; saved one customer from packet fragmentation last week.
jean: Noted. One more HSM quirk: SUSE packages put pkcs11 modules under /usr/lib64/pkcs11 vs /usr/lib/pkcs11 on debian. Could we include a tiny conditional snippet? e.g. 
```
# detect pkcs11 path (bash)
if [ -d /usr/lib64/pkcs11 ]; then
  PKCS11=/usr/lib64/pkcs11/your-hsm.so
else
  PKCS11=/usr/lib/pkcs11/your-hsm.so
fi
```
sam: Also please add a short migration note for customers moving from Dedicated HSM -> Cloud HSM (failover). They need to rotate tokens and update key aliases; a one-paragraph checklist is enough.
chad: Pushed a systemd unit example for the Windows/PowerShell helper (we run it under win32-service through NSSM in some installs but here's a plain unit for linux wrappers). Drop this in the 'tools' appendix:
```
[Unit]
Description=redwood-conn-checker
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/opt/redwood/bin/conn-checker --ipv6 --check-pkcs11
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
Also added a tiny ARM build note: curl + tar extraction uses --no-same-owner to avoid permission issues under containerized installers.
deploy-bot: docs-ci: all checks passed for PR #842 — link-linter, code-sample-scan, and staging-preview succeeded. :white_check_mark:
maria: Awesome, thanks everyone. @ashwin @jean can you each drop one-line approvals on the PR for the nftables and pkcs11 bits? I'll add the migration checklist and call out the exact MTU recommendation inline. Plan to merge tomorrow after final thumbs. :calendar:
